name: File Handling (launchQueue)
plain: Lets an installed web app open files of a given type from the file manager.
meaning: Registers the PWA as handler for file types; the file arrives as a handle once the person opens it.

access.prompt_ui: OS Open with list; first open confirm
access.iframe: Same as top level; cross-origin iframes need a permissions policy where listed

data.metric: Lets an installed web app open files of a given type from the file manager.

limits.headline: Can open files from your file manager in an installed web app, after you choose it
limits.user_action: You install the web app, then open a file with Open with and pick it
can: Appear in the Open with list for file types it supports
Open the one file you picked and show it in the app
Save changes back to that file after you confirm
cannot: Open files you did not choose
Work for a site that is not installed
Work in Firefox, Safari or on phones
Skip the confirm step the first time you open a file
limits.differs: Chrome and Edge on computers only. Phones, Firefox and Safari do not support it.

story.what_it_is: An installed web app can be set to open certain file types when you double click them.

marketing.name: File Handling
marketing.pitch: Installed web apps can register as handlers for file types, so a double click opens the file in the app.

story.for_you: You double click a picture or document and it opens in the web app, like a normal desktop program. On first use the browser may ask to confirm. You can change the default later.
story.for_makers: Makers make web apps feel native: their app shows up in Open with and as the default. It deepens habit and loyalty. It works only for installed web apps in Chromium.

use_cases.example: A web photo editor opens PNG files straight from your folder when you double click them.
A web audio editor opens a sound file from the desktop.
A web document app opens text and CSV files you double click.
A web code editor opens source files from the file manager.
A web emulator or level editor opens a save or map file with a double click.
A web video tool opens clips you dragged from a camera folder.
A web drawing app for classes opens a student's file from a shared drive.

technical_bounds: No file type registration on mobile
